title: Act: Add manifest zod schemas and inferred types
description: Create game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts defining schemas and exported inferred types.
acceptance_criteria: Module exports assetSchema and manifestSchema as zod schemas
Module exports types AssetEntry, AssetManifest, AnimationDef, FrameSpec and InteractionBounds

steps.action: Create the file importing { z } from 'zod'. Define dimensionsSchema {width,height} as positive ints; originSchema {x,y} numbers 0..1; boundsSchema {x,y numbers, width,height positive numbers}; frameSpecSchema {frameWidth,frameHeight positive ints, frameCount positive int, optional margin,spacing non-negative ints}; animationSchema {frames: nonempty array of non-negative ints, frameRate positive number, repeat int >= -1 default -1}; assetSchema {id nonempty string, path nonempty string, type enum image|spritesheet|audio, dimensions optional, frames optional, animations optional record of animationSchema, origin optional, interactionBounds optional}; manifestSchema {version literal 1, assets array of assetSchema}. Add superRefine on assetSchema: type spritesheet requires frames and dimensions. Export z.infer types AssetEntry, AssetManifest, AnimationDef, FrameSpec, InteractionBounds, Origin, Dimensions
steps.expected: Module compiles and exports schemas and types
